title: Geometric Resolution of the "Vacuum Catastrophe" Within the Framework of the 10D Electromagnetic Structure of the Atomic Nucleus
content: Within the unified theoretical framework developed in the fundamental research by Anastasia N. Vikhareva, "Electromagnetic Structure of the Atomic Nucleus in 10D Space. Prosto, Proto, and Fon — Measurements" (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20965963), a continuous physical interconnection is established between the microstructure of elementary particles and the global density parameters of the Universe. Describing reality as a dynamic interface of continuous multidimensional phases completely eliminates the "vacuum catastrophe" paradox without relying on artificial quantum constraints. The derived mathematical apparatus proves that the fundamental constants of both the microcosm and macrocosm are rigidly conjugate through the geometric properties of the spatial solenoid.
